Anglin |stadium= [[Fant–Ewing Coliseum]] |champion= |bowl= [[2016 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] |bowl_result= First round }} {{2015–16 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 Louisiana–Monroe Warhawks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Louisiana at Monroe]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Warhawks were led by sixth year head coach [[Keith Richard (basketball)|Keith Richard]], played their home games at [[Fant–Ewing Coliseum]] and were members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. They finished the season 20–14, 15–5 in Sun Belt play to finish in second place. They defeated [[2015–16 Texas–Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|Texas–Arlington]] in the semifinals of the [[2016 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]] to advance to the championship game where they lost to [[2015–16 Arkansas–Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team|Little Rock]]. They were invited to the [[2016 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CollegeInsider.com Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2015–16 Furman Paladins men's basketball team|Furman]].
